title: Business, industry and trade
summary: Activities of businesses and industry in the UK, including data on the production and trade of goods and services, sales by retailers, characteristics of businesses, the construction and manufacturing sectors, and international trade.

children.title: Business
children.summary: UK businesses registered for VAT and PAYE with regional breakdowns, including data on size (employment and turnover) and activity (type of industry), research and development, and business services.

children.title: Activity, size and location
children.summary: UK businesses broken down by location, industry, legal status and employment, and UK enterprise levels measured by turnover.

children.title: Business innovation
children.summary: Research and development in the UK carried out or funded by business enterprises, higher education, government (including research councils) and private non-profit organisations.

children.title: Business services
children.summary: Size and growth of the UK non-financial business economy as measured by the Annual Business Survey (ABS), and the value of e-commerce and the adoption and use of information and communication technologies (ICTs) by UK businesses.

children.title: Changes to business
children.summary: UK business growth, survival and change over time. These figures are an informal indicator of confidence in the UK economy.

children.title: Bankruptcy/insolvency
children.summary: UK business insolvencies, bankruptcies and other forms of debt relief.

children.title: Business births, deaths and survival rates
children.summary: Demography of UK businesses: active businesses, new registrations for VAT and PAYE (births), cessation of trading (deaths), and duration of trading (survival rates).

children.title: Mergers and acquisitions
children.summary: Business mergers and acquisitions involving UK companies, including de-mergers and disposals, where the transaction value is £1 million or more.

children.title: Construction industry
children.summary: Construction of new buildings and repairs or alterations to existing properties in Great Britain measured by the amount charged for the work, including work by civil engineering companies.

children.title: International trade
children.summary: Trade in goods and services across the UK's international borders, including total imports and exports, the types of goods and services traded and general trends in international trade.

children.title: IT and internet industry
children.summary: Internet sales by businesses in the UK (total value and as a percentage of all retail sales) and the percentage of businesses that have a website and broadband connection. These figures indicate the importance of the internet to UK businesses.

children.title: Manufacturing and production industry
children.summary: UK manufacturing and other production industries (such as mining and quarrying, energy supply, water supply and waste management), including total UK production output, and UK manufactures' sales by product and industrial division, with EU comparisons.

children.title: Retail industry
children.summary: Sales by retailers in Great Britain directly to end consumers, including spending on goods (in store and online) (Retail Sales Index) and spending on services (Index of Services). The industry as a whole is used as an indicator of how the wider economy is performing and the strength of consumer spending.

children.title: Tourism industry
children.summary: Tourism and travel (including accommodation services, food and beverage services, passenger transport services, vehicle hire, travel agencies and sports, recreational and conference services), employment levels and output of the tourism industry, the number of visitors to the UK and the amount they spend.

title: Economy
summary: UK economic activity covering production, distribution, consumption, and trade of goods and services. Individuals, businesses, organisations and governments all affect the development of the economy.

children.title: Economic output and productivity
children.summary: Manufacturing, production and services indices (measuring total economic output) and productivity (measuring efficiency).

children.title: Output
children.summary: Economic output and activity of the UK. Includes manufacturing, production and services, and other measures of economic activity.

children.title: Productivity measures
children.summary: Economic productivity measures (including output per hour, output per job and output per worker), productivity in the public sector, and international comparisons of productivity across the G7 nations.

children.title: Public services productivity
children.summary: Output, inputs and productivity estimates for public services in the UK, including estimates of healthcare and education productivity.

children.title: Environmental accounts
children.summary: How the environment contributes to the economy, the impact that the economy has on the environment, and how society responds to environmental issues. This page also hosts the development of natural capital accounts.

children.title: Government, public sector and taxes
children.summary: How the relationship between UK public sector income and expenditure leads to changes in deficit and debt.

children.title: Local government finance
children.summary: Spending on science, engineering and technology by central government departments, research councils and higher education funding councils (HEFCs).

children.title: Public sector finance
children.summary: How the relationship between UK public sector monthly income and expenditure leads to changes in deficit and debt.

children.title: Public spending
children.summary: UK government debt and deficit as reported each January, April, July and October.

children.title: Research and development expenditure
children.summary: Research and development in the UK carried out or funded by business enterprises, higher education, government (including research councils) and private non-profit organisations.

children.title: Taxes and revenue
children.summary: The effect of taxes and benefits on UK household’s income.

children.title: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
children.summary: Gross domestic product (GDP) estimates are the main measure of UK economic growth based on the value of goods and services produced during a given period. GDP estimates are produced monthly, quarterly and annually as part of the revisions cycle to ensure the timely release of data throughout the year. Our GDP monthly estimate consists of output data and is our most timely official estimate of economic growth. The two publication stages for quarterly estimates are our GDP first quarterly estimate and our quarterly national accounts, which include data on output, expenditure and income.

children.title: Gross Value Added (GVA)
children.summary: Estimates of regional gross value added (GVA), which is the value generated by any unit engaged in the production of goods and services. Figures available for local authorities and NUTS regions.

children.title: Inflation and price indices
children.summary: The rate of inflation is the change in prices for goods and services over time. Measures of inflation and prices include consumer price inflation, producer price inflation and the House Price Index.

children.title: Investments, pensions and trusts
children.summary: Net flows of investment into the UK, the number of people who hold pensions of different types, and investments made by various types of trusts.

children.title: National accounts
children.summary: The national accounts framework brings units and transactions together to provide a simple and understandable description of production, income, consumption, accumulation, and wealth.

children.title: Balance of payments
children.summary: All economic transactions between residents of the UK and the rest of the world.

children.title: Satellite accounts
children.summary: Accounts that cover activities linked to the economy but not part of the core UK national accounts including environmental accounts, tourism satellite account, and household satellite accounts.

children.title: Supply and use tables
children.summary: Balances showing the relationship between components of value added, industry inputs and outputs, and product supply and demand. A source for the data underlying gross domestic product (GDP).

children.title: UK sector accounts
children.summary: Transactions of particular groups of institutions within the UK economy, showing how the income from production is distributed and how savings are used to add wealth through investment in assets.

children.title: Regional accounts
children.summary: Accounts for regions, sub-regions and local areas of the UK, allowing comparisons between regions and against a UK average. Including regional gross value added (GVA) and regional gross disposable household income.

children.title: Gross disposable household income
children.summary: Gross disposable household income is the amount of money that individuals in the household sector can spend or save after income distribution measures. Figures cover regions, sub-regions and local areas of the UK.

title: Employment and labour market
summary: People in and out of work covering employment, unemployment, types of work, earnings, working patterns and workplace disputes.

children.title: People in work
children.summary: Employment data covering employment rates, hours of work and earnings.

children.title: Earnings and working hours
children.summary: Average weekly earnings of people in the UK and information on the gender pay gap and low pay. Data from Average Weekly Earnings (AWE) and the Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE).

children.title: Employment and employee types
children.summary: Employment rates show the number of people in paid work as a proportion of the population, broken down by age and sex. Includes information on the number of people in employment and vacancies.

children.title: Labour productivity
children.summary: Efficiency of the UK workforce, including output per worker, per job and per hour. Data are available by industry and by region.

children.title: Public sector personnel
children.summary: People employed in central and local government, and public corporations, including second jobs in the public sector. Includes Civil Service employment with regional and diversity analyses.

children.title: Workplace disputes and working conditions
children.summary: Work stoppages because of disputes between employers and employees. Includes strikes and lock-outs, number of days lost in the public and private sectors, and number of workers involved.

children.title: Workplace pensions
children.summary: Pensions linked to a person's workplace, including defined ambition (DA), defined benefit (DB) and defined contribution (DC) schemes.

children.title: People not in work
children.summary: Unemployed and economically inactive people in the UK including claimants of out-of-work benefits and the number of redundancies.

children.title: Economic inactivity
children.summary: People not in employment who have not been seeking work within the last 4 weeks and/or are unable to start work within the next 2 weeks.

children.title: Out of work benefits
children.summary: Claimants of unemployment related benefits including Employment and Support Allowance and other incapacity benefits, and Income Support and Pension Credit.

children.title: Redundancies
children.summary: People who have been made redundant or have taken voluntary redundancy.

children.title: Unemployment
children.summary: UK unemployment figures. Information on the labour market, young people and workless households.

title: People, population and community
summary: Residents of the UK, population changes, how we spend our money, and data on crime, relationships, health and religion. Statistics that help us build a detailed picture of how we live.

children.title: Armed forces community
children.summary: Information about the armed forces community, including those who have previously served in the armed forces (veterans) and their families, to help support the Armed Forces Covenant.

children.title: Births, deaths and marriages
children.summary: Life events in the UK including fertility rates, live and stillbirths, family composition, life expectancy and deaths.

children.title: Adoption
children.summary: Adoption registrations including the age and gender of the children being adopted and whether they were born inside marriage.

children.title: Ageing
children.summary: Life expectancy factors and indicators of the health of the elderly in the UK. Statistics to help us understand the needs of an ageing population.

children.title: Conception and fertility rates
children.summary: Childbearing, conceptions, births and abortions in the UK. Statistics on average family size and maternity trends among women, by age and area.

children.title: Deaths
children.summary: Deaths broken down by age, sex, area and cause of death.

children.title: Divorce
children.summary: Divorces including same- and opposite-sex marriages, sex and age of people divorcing, children of divorced couples and previous marital status.

children.title: Families
children.summary: Number and type of families and households including young adults living with their parents, lone parents, cohabiting couples, multi-generational households and people living alone.

children.title: Life expectancies
children.summary: How long, on average, people can expect to live using estimates of the population and the number of deaths.

children.title: Live births
children.summary: Live births by age, sex, marital status, country of birth, socio-economic status, previous children and UK area of parent. Also includes trends in baby names.

children.title: Marriage, cohabitation and civil partnerships
children.summary: Marriages and civil partnerships formed and dissolved, and estimates of the population by marital status and living arrangements.

children.title: Maternities
children.summary: Women having babies (including stillbirths). A maternity is a pregnancy resulting in the birth of 1 or more children, therefore, these figures are not the same as the number of babies born.

children.title: Stillbirths
children.summary: Stillbirths including cause of death and sex, and analyses by some of the main risk factors affecting stillbirths, including parent age and birthweight.

children.title: Crime and justice
children.summary: Crime levels and trends based primarily on the Crime Survey for England and Wales (CSEW) and police recorded crime data.

children.title: Cultural identity
children.summary: How people in the UK identify in terms of ethnicity, sexual identity, religion and language, and how this has changed over time using a diverse range of data sources.

children.title: Ethnicity
children.summary: Ethnicity, national identity and religion in the UK and non-UK born population.

children.title: Gender identity
children.summary: Information about people’s gender identity from Census 2021.

children.title: Language
children.summary: The proportion of adults using English as their main language and a breakdown of other languages used in the UK and the multilingual population.

children.title: Religion
children.summary: Religious affiliation, including religions among the non-UK born population in England and Wales.

children.title: Sexual orientation
children.summary: People's self identified sexual orientation, from Census 2021 data and the Annual Population survey.

children.title: Education and childcare
children.summary: Early years' childcare, school and college education, higher education and adult learning, including data and analysis on qualifications, personnel, and safety and well-being.

children.title: Elections
children.summary: Analysis of the number of people registered to vote, including comparisons over time and between the UK constituent countries.

children.title: Electoral registration
children.summary: The number of people in the UK and its constituent countries registered to vote in local government and Parliamentary elections.

children.title: General elections
children.summary: Forms of civic engagement, including satisfaction with government and democracy, interest in politics and participation in politics.

children.title: Local government elections
children.summary: Individuals’ engagement with local government, including involvement in decision-making.

children.title: Health and social care
children.summary: Life expectancy, health inequalities, disability and addiction as well as access to and expenditure on private and public healthcare systems.

children.title: Causes of death
children.summary: Mortality statistics on deaths registered by age, sex and underlying cause of deaths, including data and analysis on deaths involving the coronavirus (COVID-19).

children.title: Child health
children.summary: Children's health and well-being including childhood, infant and perinatal mortality, childhood cancer survival and illness.

children.title: Coronavirus (COVID-19)
children.summary: Latest data and analysis on coronavirus (COVID-19) in the UK and its effect on the economy and society.

children.title: Disability
children.summary: The lives of disabled people in the UK, including disparities, outcomes for disabled people and impact on day-to-day activities.

children.title: Drug use, alcohol and smoking
children.summary: Smoking, drinking and drug taking in Great Britain and associated deaths and illnesses.

children.title: Health care system
children.summary: Information about private and public healthcare systems in the UK.

children.title: Health inequalities
children.summary: Current patterns and trends in ill health and death by measures of socio-economic status.

children.title: Health and life expectancies
children.summary: Comparisons and inequalities in healthy life expectancies, disability-free life expectancies and life expectancies.

children.title: Health and well-being
children.summary: Analyses of social and economic data from government and other organisations to paint a picture of UK society and how it changes, including comparisons with other countries.

children.title: Mental health
children.summary: Mental health of children, adolescents and adults.

children.title: Social care
children.summary: People who require social care, as well as those who work in social care, performance levels, and its financial cost.

children.title: Household characteristics
children.summary: The composition of households, including those who live alone, overcrowding and under-occupation, as well as internet and social media usage.

children.title: Home internet and social media usage
children.summary: Use of the internet and social media broken down by characteristics such as age and sex, including number of people who have used the internet, those who use the internet frequently and those who have never used the internet.

children.title: Housing
children.summary: Property price, private rent and household statistics.

children.title: Leisure and tourism
children.summary: Tourism to the UK, and UK residents travelling abroad, reasons for travel and money spent. The statistics on UK residents travelling abroad are an informal indicator of living standards.

children.title: Personal and household finances
children.summary: Income and earnings, spending and saving, and wealth and debt. These statistics help build a picture of how living standards and inequality have changed.

children.title: Debt
children.summary: Debt of UK households, broken down by financial debt and property debt.

children.title: Expenditure
children.summary: Spending patterns of UK households.

children.title: Income and wealth
children.summary: UK household income and wealth.

children.title: Pensions, savings and investments
children.summary: State, private, occupational and workplace pensions, including pension trends that draws together data from other government departments and organisations.

children.title: Population and migration
children.summary: Size, age, sex and geographic distribution of the UK population, including data on international migration, migration within the UK, changes in the population and the factors driving these changes.

children.title: International migration
children.summary: People moving into and out of the UK.

children.title: Migration within the UK
children.summary: Movement of people within the UK, between local authorities and regions in England and Wales and to or from Scotland and Northern Ireland.

children.title: Population estimates
children.summary: Annual population estimates. Figures are available for various administrative and electoral geographies and for different population sub-groups, for example, estimates of the very old and estimates by marital status.

children.title: Population projections
children.summary: Projections of the future size and age structure of the population of the UK and its constituent countries. Based on mid-year population estimates and assumptions of future fertility, mortality and migration.

children.title: Measuring progress, well-being and beyond GDP
children.summary: Exploring progress in the UK using statistics on economy, environment and society
